Material information: BOPP/VMPET/PE. Opening reference: Zipper Top. Separate loose leaves from finely milled matcha when sizing this pack. Leaves need opening clearance without crushing; fine powder makes zipper and seal contamination more likely. Light exposure, aroma change and moisture pickup should be evaluated with the actual tea rather than inferred from green artwork or a paper appearance.
